Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public. 




Mazdoor Kisan Shakti Sangathan 
"The Right to Information, The Right to Live"

IS: 10994 ( Part7)-1984 




Indian Standard ( Rea ffirmed 2005 ) 

SPECIFICATION FOR 
CARTRIDGES FOR SHOT GUNS 

PART 7 DISCS 



1. Scope — Covers discs for shot gun cartridges. 

2. Dimensions — As given in Fig. 1 . 



+0.15 

4> 18.35 o mm-

♦0.15

1,30 mm-J

DISC 

FIG. 1 DIMENSIONS FOR DISCS 

3. Material — The index disc shall be made from mill board/straw board conforming to Grade A of 
IS : 2617-1967 'Specification for mill board, grey board and straw board {first revision)' and the disc 
shall be made from mill board/straw board conforming to Grade B of IS : 2617-1967. 

4. Other Requirements — As given in IS : 10994 ( Part 1 )-1984 'Specification for cartridges for 
shot guns: Part 1 General requirements'. 



C V D I A M A T r\ D V 



M n T C 



Discs are used in the assembly of shot gun cartridges for compartmentalization and to ensure 
proper functioning. 

This Indian Standard ( IS : 10994 ) is being issued in the following parts, part 1 covering general 
requirements for shot gun cartridges and subsequent parts covering the individual components: 

Part 1 General requirements 

Part 2 Blank cartridges 

Part 3 Case empty 

Part 4 Cap filled 

Part 5 Anvil 

Part 6 Propellent 

Part 7 Discs 

Part 8 Air cushion 

Part 9 Lead shots 



Adopted 28 August 1984
